jei.fastfurnacev2.alloyer_duration: %s base ticks; -100 per horizontal lava (400 minimum)
jei.fastfurnacev2.accelerator_conversion: %s–%s fully boosted conversions, depending on recipe
jei.fastfurnacev2.accelerator_no_full_co: Not enough work for one fully boosted conversion
jei.fastfurnacev2.crushing_output_chance: %s–%s%% chance for %s items by crusher tier
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_furnace: 150% speed (200% with Fast Coal; 250% with Extreme Coal) and a 10% fuel doubling chance.
jei.fastfurnacev2.iron_fast_furnace: 200% speed (250% with Fast Coal; 300% with Extreme Coal) and a 15% fuel doubling chance.
jei.fastfurnacev2.gold_fast_furnace: 250% speed (300% with Fast Coal; 350% with Extreme Coal) and a 20% fuel doubling chance.
jei.fastfurnacev2.diamond_fast_furnace: 300% speed (350% with Fast Coal; 400% with Extreme Coal) and a 25% fuel doubling chance.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_crusher: Crushes raw ore into two crushed items and mod ore blocks into three items at 150% speed (200% with Fast Coal; 250% with Extreme Coal), with a 10% chance to double the complete result. A blocked doubled result waits for room. Fuel duration is not doubled.
jei.fastfurnacev2.iron_fast_crusher: Crushes raw ore into two crushed items and mod ore blocks into three items at 200% speed (250% with Fast Coal; 300% with Extreme Coal), with a 15% chance to double the complete result. A blocked doubled result waits for room. Fuel duration is not doubled.
jei.fastfurnacev2.gold_fast_crusher: Crushes raw ore into two crushed items and mod ore blocks into three items at 250% speed (300% with Fast Coal; 350% with Extreme Coal), with a 20% chance to double the complete result. A blocked doubled result waits for room. Fuel duration is not doubled.
jei.fastfurnacev2.diamond_fast_crusher: Crushes raw ore into two crushed items and mod ore blocks into three items at 300% speed (350% with Fast Coal; 400% with Extreme Coal), with a 25% chance to double the complete result. A blocked doubled result waits for room. Fuel duration is not doubled.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_cobblestone: Mine stone with a correct tool and no Silk Touch: 10% chance of a bonus alongside normal drops, +5% per Fortune level. Also drops itself when mined with a pickaxe.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_coal: Mine coal ore or deepslate coal ore with a correct tool and no Silk Touch: 10% chance of a bonus alongside normal drops, +5% per Fortune level, or convert coal in an Accelerator. Burns like coal normally; in Fast Furnaces, lasts 50–125% longer and adds 50 percentage points to speed.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_coal_block: Craft 9 Fast Coal into this block and unpack it back into 9, or convert a coal block in an Accelerator. Burns like a coal block normally; receives Fast Coal bonuses in Fast Furnaces.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extreme_coal_ore: Each regular coal ore has an independent 5% chance to become Extreme Coal Ore in new chunks and once in existing chunks. Drops Extreme Coal with Fortune scaling, or itself with Silk Touch. Crush it for three Extreme Coal.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extreme_coal: Mine Extreme Coal Ore or its deepslate variant, or crush either ore for three Extreme Coal. Burns like coal normally; doubles Fast Coal's added speed and burn-duration bonuses in Fast Furnaces and Fast Crushers. In an Accelerator, supplies 7,200 work at 5× speed.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extreme_coal_block: Craft 9 Extreme Coal into this block and unpack it back into 9. Burns like a coal block normally; receives Extreme Coal bonuses in Fast Furnaces and Fast Crushers. In an Accelerator, supplies 8,000 work at 5× speed.
jei.fastfurnacev2.deepslate_extreme_coal: Each deepslate coal ore has an independent 5% chance to become Deepslate Extreme Coal Ore. Drops Extreme Coal with Fortune scaling, or itself with Silk Touch. Crush it for three Extreme Coal.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_ore: Each matching regular or deepslate ore has an independent 5% chance to become its Fast variant. Drops raw Fast material with Fortune scaling, or the ore itself with Silk Touch. Crush the ore block for three crushed Fast materials.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_raw_material: Mine the matching Fast ore. Smelt directly into one Fast material, or crush into two crushed items that each smelt into one Fast material.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_material: Smelt the matching raw or crushed Fast material, or convert the ordinary material in an Accelerator. Craft nine into a reversible storage block.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_material_block: Craft nine matching Fast materials into this reversible storage block, or convert the ordinary block in an Accelerator. Used in Fast Furnace and Fast Crusher upgrades.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_iron_tool: An iron tool with 20% faster block breaking. Repair with Fast Iron Ingots.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_iron_sword: An iron sword with 20% faster attacks. Repair with Fast Iron Ingots.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_gold_tool: A golden tool with 30% faster block breaking. Repair with Fast Gold Ingots.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_gold_sword: A golden sword with 30% faster attacks. Repair with Fast Gold Ingots.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_diamond_tool: A diamond tool with 20% faster block breaking and a 5% chance to avoid durability damage. Repair with Fast Diamonds.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_diamond_sword: A diamond sword with 20% faster attacks, 20% more attack damage, and a 5% chance to avoid durability damage. Repair with Fast Diamonds.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extremely_fast_tool: Double diamond durability, 50% faster block breaking, built-in Fortune II, and an independent 5% chance to double block drops. Repair with Extremely Fast Ingots.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extremely_fast_sword: Double diamond-sword durability, 50% faster attacks, built-in Looting II, an independent 5% chance to double kill drops, and an independent 10% chance to deal double damage. Repair with Extremely Fast Ingots.
jei.fastfurnacev2.accelerator_info: Converts coal, iron, gold, diamond, and their blocks into Fast variants. Requires lava on all four horizontal sides. Fast Coal and its block optionally triple processing speed; Extreme Coal and its block provide 5× speed.
jei.fastfurnacev2.alloyer_info: Combines three shapeless ingredients using only Extreme Coal fuel. The 800-tick base recipe loses 100 ticks per horizontal lava side, down to 400 ticks. Its eleven-stage top bolt shows progress.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extremely_fast_ingot_i: Alloy one Fast Iron Ingot, one Fast Gold Ingot, and one Fast Diamond in an Extremely Fast Alloyer.
